notes.title: Hikari Update & Steam Summer Sale 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers![/h1][p]
We have just released two things, new #DRIVE Rally Hikari Update and new 30% Steam Summer Sale!
[/p][h2]Hikari Update - Patch Notes v1.1.0.2[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Today’s update continues our ongoing support for #DRIVE Rally following its 1.0 release. [/b][/p][p]We’d like to say a massive [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who’s been playing, leaving feedback, posting reviews, and reporting bugs. The good, the bad, and everything in between – we’re listening, and it genuinely helps us make the game better.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s New? Penalty System Rework[/h3][p]One of the biggest focuses of this update is a [b]complete overhaul of the penalty system[/b] – something we’ve been wanting to revisit for a while now.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Old System[/h3][p]Previously, the penalty system worked like this:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]If you went off-road (even slightly), you got [b]slowed down[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you hit racing tapes or nets, you got [b]slowed down even more[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you went too far off-road, your car would be [b]reset to the road[/b] and you’d get a [b]3-second time penalty[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/98662fd3fc9f8e8c0228ceb7807c9a5ac988c4a6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With the old penalty system, two main problems started to show.[/p][p]First, [b]corner cutting was just too effective[/b] — going full speed through turns and going offroad didn’t slow you down enough to make it a bad idea. And then there was the unexpected one: some players figured out that instead of braking into a corner, they could just slam straight through racing tapes or nets to slow the car down instead. [b]People were using our track barriers as a braking tool[/b]. That's not exactly what we designed them for.[/p][p][/p][h3]The New System[/h3][p]So, here’s what we’ve changed:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]We’ve [b]removed the slowdown effect[/b] for simply going slightly off-road (like with 1 or 2 wheels).[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve [b]reduced heavily the slowdown effect[/b] for hitting racing objects like tapes and nets.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead, if you go far enough off the main route, you’ll now see a [b]new “OFFROAD!” warning popup[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]While in OFFROAD popup is active, your car will be slowed down [b]until you return closer to the main road[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Go even deeper off-track? Just like before, your car will [b]reset[/b] and you’ll get a [b]3-second penalty[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/8b301d6df1d03b2598b8b38aab6c3d996d7f62c4.gif"][/img][/p][p]We believe this approach will [b]encourage more technical and skillful driving[/b], while at the same time [b]discouraging unrealistic stage cutting[/b] and making most of the old skipping spots useless.[/p][p][/p][h3]Leaderboard Reset[/h3][p]Since this update significantly changes how you race, we’ve decided to [b]reset all online leaderboards[/b]. It’s a fresh start for everyone to compete fairly using the improved penalty system. So grab your favorite car, hit the track, and go climb that board![/p][p][/p][h3]New Car[/h3][p]We are also adding a totally new car - Hikari 1995, available in three classes: CL, RS, and XR. With 6 unique livery designs and 12 color presets, available for in-game $500 each.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/4668f5fb308892b6222886c02d408221878ee5b3.gif"][/img][/h3][p]Hikari XR 1995[/p][p][/p][h3]New Music[/h3][p]Okay, we’ll admit it — that main menu beat was getting a bit old. If you've played the game for more than ten minutes, you’ve definitely heard it on loop at least 300 times. We knew it was time for a change.[/p][p]So, we went digging. Really digging and hey, we found some absolute bangers.[/p][p]Now, when you boot up the game, you’ll be greeted by [b]“Eigengrau” by Nihilore[/b] instead of that same old womp-womp loop. It’s fresh, it slaps, and it sets the mood a lot better. But that’s not all — we’ve added a full lineup of new tracks that you’ll hear during the racing.[/p][p]They come from some seriously cool artists: [url="https://www.nihilore.com"][b]Nihilore[/b][/url], [url="https://hellstarplus.bandcamp.com/music"][b]hellstar.plus[/b][/url], [url="https://rozkol.bandcamp.com"][b]ROZKOL[/b][/url] and [url="https://chezmonplaisir.bandcamp.com/music"][b]Rrrrrose Azerty[/b][/url]. All the tracks are released under Creative Commons Attribution licenses ([url="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/"]3.0[/url] and [url="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/"]4.0[/url]), which means we can share them with you directly in the game, and credit the awesome artist behind them properly.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Playlist[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Nihilore[/b][/p][list][*][p]Eigengrau (new main menu track)[/p][/*][*][p]No Escape[/p][/*][*][p]We Were Young, We Were Wrong, We Were Gone[/p][/*][*][p]Used[/p][/*][*][p]Nobody[/p][/*][*][p]Do Not Look Back[/p][/*][*][p]Parasite[/p][/*][*][p]Hunger[/p][/*][*][p]Motion Blur[/p][/*][*][p]Send Help[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]hellstar.plus[/b][/p][list][*][p]dm_02[/p][/*][*][p]GIRL MODE[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]ROZKOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chase Scene[/p][/*][*][p]Club Thump[/p][/*][*][p]Hitchhiker Effect (Instrumental)[/p][/*][*][p]Machine Masochist[/p][/*][*][p]Serf Song[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Rrrrrose Azerty[/b][/p][list][*][p]Drifting on the fash[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Report Form[/h3][p]If you would like to report any issues with the game please use our [url="https://forms.clickup.com/24321588/f/q67hm-16395/YRTFUIVZZB1L7GNN7O"]Bug Report Form[/url].  You can also share your feedback about the new update, here on Steam Forum or join the [url="https://discord.gg/drivegame"]official #DRIVE Discord[/url] server.   [/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][h2] [/h2][h2]Steam Summer Sale 2025!
[/h2][p][b]#DRIVE Rally is now 30% off[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale 2025!

🎉 From [b]June 26th until July 10th, 10AM PT[/b], you can grab the game at a sweet discount and hit the dirt if you haven’t already.
[/p][p]Whether you're new to the rally world or coming back for more after trying the demo – now’s a great time to jump in and make some dust around Tofuyama, Holzberg, or the desert sands of Dry Crumbs!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2494780/DRIVE_Rally"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44741181/cc19da7ae05d398472bd8fbd36cf2aecf5393e4b.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2]To the #DRIVE Rally Community:[/h2][p]Thank you for your continued support and for playing #DRIVE Rally! We’ve seen some wild leaderboard results and an incredible amount of total playtime. We truly appreciate it all! If you have a moment, we’d love to hear your thoughts through a Steam review. notes.title: #DRIVE Rally 1.0 is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers![/h1]

The wait is over — #DRIVE Rally has officially crossed the finish line into full release!
After months of Early Access, community feedback, and tireless work, version 1.0 is here, ready to bring you the full-blown rally experience. From the roar of engines to the spray of gravel under your tires, it's all been fine-tuned for speed, precision, and pure rally joy. Whether you're competing for the best times in Championships, cruising through Free Roam, or challenging your friends in Party Mode — there's never been a better time to jump in.

And to celebrate launch, [b]#DRIVE Rally is available with a 30% discount[/b] for a limited time!

[b]#DRIVE Rally 1.0 Main Features:[/b][list]
[*][b]Redefined Arcade Racing[/b] – easy to pick up, challenging to master.
[*][b]Local Party Mode[/b] – up to 12 players take turns racing for the top spot in leaderboard!
[*][b]Free Roam Mode with collectibles[/b] – explore and unlock interior decors.
[*][b]Global Leaderboards with saved Ghosts[/b] – chase records and race yourself.
[*][b]6 Passionate Co-Drivers with their own Championships[/b] – complete them and unlock more cars.
[*][b]22 Customizable Legendary Cars[/b] – each in 3 rally classes.
[*][b]Over 600 km of Rally Stages in 6 iconic locations[/b] – from snowy Finland to the deserts of the USA.
[*][b]Perfect shots with Photo Mode[/b] – capture your rally moments.
[*][b]Controller and Wheel Support[/b] – including force feedback.
[*][b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] – play anywhere, anytime.[/list]

[previewyoutube=s9xK8RjQxC8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]PLAY NOW[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2494780/DRIVE_Rally/

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Welcome to Tofuyama[/h2]
Drift through the tight streets and scenic coastlines of Tofuyama! With 24 normal and 24 reversed rally stages, this vibrant city map blends seaside cliffs, tranquil lakes, iconic bridges, and cherry blossom-lined roads into a true driver’s playground. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/458f2c5d316313da2cabba6fe6aba9771c7d5c05.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/6e6ac0508829896a06818779b945481070ac6540.jpg[/img]

[h2]Co-Pilot Yoshiro[/h2]
Meet Yoshiro, the calm and composed Co-Pilot from the DejaVu Repairs Team. With a deep understanding of the winding mountain roads of Tofuyama, Yoshiro delivers clear and precise calls to keep you ahead of the curve. Focused, confident, and cool under pressure—he’s the perfect partner for tackling the toughest rally challenges. When Yoshiro’s in the passenger seat, you know it’s time to drive at your best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/fc8549da293ce98539b3fa7f0432285b5076b5c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]DejaVu Repairs Team Championships[/h2]
Join Yoshiro and the DejaVu Repairs Team in the heart of Tofuyama, where sharp turns and coastal climbs await. Starting your journey with the agile and iconic The Froggie CL, you'll push your limits through cherry blossom-lined streets, cliffside bridges, serene lakes, and neon-lit mountain passes. Master the demanding stages and prove you've got what it takes to climb the ranks and earn your place among the best of DejaVu Repairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/9f36b8fb1a72ef10369dd4223c4a0ad1d11260ee.jpg[/img]

[h2]Party Mode[/h2]

Get the crew together and turn up the competition in Party Mode – a brand-new local hot seat multiplayer experience! Up to 12 players take turns racing on selected stages, each trying to clock the best time and climb the leaderboard. Pick your favorite car, choose a stage, pass the controller, and let the rally madness begin. Perfect for couch competitions and bragging rights – may the fastest driver win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/e30e8892c543eda1aabc8c6934920713ffde4faa.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cars[/h2]
Three brand-new cars are making their debut, each with three car classes and over 40 different parts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/e7c67967737ae7ba6cb31f48065a0324a12b679e.gif[/img]
The Froggie 1970

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/aaff42e0956c0ef4e3fed1ad774bd7475d193014.gif[/img]
Hachitofu 1985

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/444758bd4c05782c2e717d4be1b0ebba1884f7bf.gif[/img]
The Clouder 1994

[hr][/hr]

[b]Patch Notes v1.0.0.0[/b]

[b]Championship Mode Progression Changes[/b][list]
[*] The Championship selection screen now includes a "Reset Progress" button, allowing you to reset progress for individual championships.
[*] Championship progression has been reworked: you now need to complete specific championships to unlock corresponding cars.
[*] If you played during Early Access and purchased a car before completing its respective championship, it will remain unlocked.
[*] Only The Geneve, The Doggo, La Lunette, and The Croquet will be available for purchase without completing a championship, as they were added during Early Access and aren't tied to any progression.
[/list]
[b]New Features & Content[/b][list]
[*] Unique sound effects for every car in the game.
[*] Added new map: Tofuyama with 24 normal and 24 reversed rally stages.
[*] Added new co-pilot: Yoshiro
[*] Added new team and championships: DejaVu Repairs
[*] Added Party Mode (Hot Seat local multiplayer for up to 12 players).
[*] Added 3 new cars in 3 classes each.
[*] Added 5 new interior collectibles.
[*] Added 7 collectible letters on the Tofuyama map.
[*] Added 4 new achievements.
[*] Added new environment sound effects to all locations.
[*] Updated dirt and drift sound effects.
[*] All Global Leaderboards have been reset.

[/list]
[b]Gameplay & UI Improvements[/b][list]
[*] Added gameplay option to change keyboard steering input curve.
[*] Added gameplay option to change Keyboard setting type curve.
[*] Added gameplay option to change Gamepad setting type curve.
[*] Added "Steering Wheel" curve to the Gamepad setting type option.
[*] Added gameplay option slider to adjust gamepad deadzone.
[*] Added gameplay option to toggle off gamepad vibration or change its strength.
[*] Added gameplay option to reset all Championships progress.
[*] Improved textures optimization.
[*] Improved asset loading times.
[*] Updated localization and in-game UI translations.
[*] Added car covers for locked cars in Quick Race UI.
[*] Added new UI status for cars locked behind Championships progression.
[*] Updated steering wheel sizes in car interiors.
[*] Updated racing assets penalties.

[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed issues with missing Ghosts in Global Leaderboards.
[*] Fixed issues with missing times in Global Leaderboards.
[*] Fixed issues with loading wrong car class data in Global Leaderboards.
[*] Fixed issues with unlocking collectible letters in Free Roam while offline.
[*] Fixed issues with maps displayed as locked in Free Roam Mode UI.
[*] Fixed achievements not tracking progress correctly.
[*] Fixed collision issues in Championship UI 3D assets.
[*] Fixed saving issues related to Championship progression.
[*] Fixed Championship Leaderboards data view in the logbook.
[*] Fixed missing Co-Driver photos in the Championship logbook.
[*] Fixed Co-Driver voiceover glitches.
[*] Fixed steering wheel and gamepad recognizing.
[*] Fixed missing racing assets.
[/list]

notes.title: Rio Guacamole Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers![/h1]

We’re excited to bring you a new update (v.0.6.0.3) that adds tons of content to #DRIVE Rally, including a brand-new map, cars, and features! Here’s what you can expect:

[previewyoutube=p-r95IzPUgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Welcome to Rio Guacamole[/h2]
Race through the vibrant streets and diverse landscapes of Rio Guacamole! With 24 regular tracks and 24 reversed tracks, this new map is packed with action—whether you're tearing through the desert, cruising the colorful city streets, or navigating the wild jungle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/739b1022b91c39491fe8b32336f2aba1db9c992e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/43003151a19586a3efe67a5cf3f70ace0c01f356.jpg[/img]

[h2]Co-Pilot Juan[/h2]
Say hello to Juan, your new Co-Pilot from the PepperBoi Racing Team! Leaving behind his mariachi lifestyle, Juan’s here to guide you through every twist and turn on the tracks. With his quick calls and charm, you’ll have the support you need to conquer Rio Guacamole’s toughest challenges. He’s ready to race—are you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/0488deb9871f1c237f1f9e31fccb7c760c33e159.jpg[/img]

[h2]PepperBoi Team Championships[/h2]
The PepperBoi Team Championships set in Rio Guacamole will put your skills to the test as you team up with Juan and the crew. Starting with the tough and stylish The Ladybug CL, you’ll race across the vibrant desert, city streets, and jungle wilds. Compete in exciting stages, and see if you’ve got what it takes to rise through the ranks with the PepperBoi Team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/84f8a532fa2c1ba3b4fa2ff6e82aa271c9345ae8.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Cars[/h2]
Three brand-new cars are making their debut, each with three car classes and over 40 different parts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/22b33293b301b434e779ba45be97d6d67a4345e4.gif[/img]
The High Five 1981

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/fd14260f405758e8a9565fc87fa80a1219adcae9.gif[/img]
The Shustryy 1977

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/80a00a4fdbee3300b021e4cff5242a1f20d6c3ad.gif[/img]
The Ladybug 1973 

Plus, with 12 color options and 6 patterns for each car, the customization possibilities are almost endless!

[h2]Free Roam Mode[/h2]
Explore maps at your own pace, get familiar with every turn, and discover exciting bonuses like car upgrades or extra in-game cash. Collect all 7 hidden letters scattered across the map to unlock the next location for Free Roam exploration. The available maps for Free Roam now include:

[list]
[*] Holzberg
[*] Dry Crumbs
[*] Revontuli
[*] Vinh Vang
[*] Rio Guacamole
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/a040d810b194ce40fba248146673e4e6d61f342d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Free Roam Mini Map[/h2]
To make navigation easier, the Free Roam mode comes equipped with a mini map that helps you find your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/e59e250a17b2a62e898ccf827c072d0d155b0fd7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Car Dashboard & Mirror Addons[/h2]
Each map features 5 hidden addons for your car’s dashboard and mirror. Once unlocked, you can customize your car’s interior in the garage. Each vehicle can be equipped with one dashboard and one mirror addon to personalize your ride.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/4a76d48a778ff2a72fb263e7e34b06445e9713aa.gif[/img]

[h2]Finally, a Human Touch[/h2]
We heard your feedback and decided to address it, and we’re pleased to announce that you can see your Co-Pilot and Driver sitting inside the car. No more ghostly self-driving cars. From this point on, your Co-Pilot Juan and others will be right there with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/c0538deac7bd4e2138fdfefd71696644889e61c3.jpg[/img]

Behind-Car Camera & Top-Down Camera: You’ll see your Co-Pilot and Driver.
Interior Camera: You’ll see your Co-Pilot, your Driver hands are hidden.

[h2]New Achievements & PhotoMode Stickers[/h2]
We’ve introduced 8 new achievements tied to the Rio Guacamole Map and Free Roam Mode, offering fresh challenges and rewards for players to unlock. Alongside the new content, we’ve expanded PhotoMode with brand-new stickers—bringing the total to 74 stickers—so you can capture your rally adventures with even more style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/405e6dedee39c847c71d220b0bbef3a4f6f970dc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Geneve Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers![/h1]

New Update for #DRIVE Rally (v0.5.2.1) is live! This update introduces the brand-new car—The Geneve 1975—along with significant improvements to the time penalty system. We’ve also added new features to tackle excessive corner-cutting and incorporated various Quality of Life improvements suggested by the community.

[previewyoutube=vQcB_zdvoj0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Version 0.5.1.7 -> v0.5.2.1[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced a slow-down feature that activates when you stray too far off-road.
[*] Added extra safety tire walls to all short rally stages across all maps to prevent corner-cutting.
The remaining tracks will be updated in future patches.
[*] Disabled time penalties for breaking racing objects (tapes, nets, flags, direction signs, tire walls). While you'll still be slowed down when hitting them, no additional penalties will apply.
[*] Disabled time penalty for Car Resetting. [i]Wrecking a car is a punishment in itself.[/i]
[*] Added top-down camera option. – now you can experience the race like in the classic #DRIVE game [/list][b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*] Gamepad input adjustments for better control.
[*] Tweaked drifting physics for smoother handling.
[*] Fixes to car colliders.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741181/696cd4a75114b6f60e894912bb201deaad051d48.png[/img]New racing perspective.

New Demo update is available to download right now. Below is the list of major changes you can expect.

Your #DRIVE just got way smoother! We've tweaked the car physics and braking to make handling more natural and responsive, so from now on you can brake smoothly and drift easier while cutting those sharp corners. Co-pilots reactions were also balanced, we have reduced amount of one-liners that you could hear during the crashes or while passing race checkpoint. From now on, when you cover a given rally stage for the first time, you will see your ghost on that route with your best time so far. The Ghost will update every time you beat your Global leaderboard time record. If you don't want to stress about having to set the best time, you can always turn off the Ghost at any time in game Options menu.

notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers!👋[/h1]
We are thrilled to announce that #DRIVE Rally will be released into Early Access in 2024! As a small but dedicated team at Pixel Perfect Dude, we are excited to invite you to be a part of our journey as we shape and refine #DRIVE Rally into an exceptional rally racing experience.

[h1]What is #DRIVE Rally?[/h1]
Relive the golden era of rally racing with #DRIVE Rally, a game that not only captures but also reignites the spirit of the '90s for a new generation of drivers. #DRIVE Rally invites all, whether a seasoned driver or a newcomer, to experience the joy and challenge the dirt roads have to offer.

[previewyoutube=4J7UnJNRLcw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Early Access Q&A[/h1]

[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2]
[i]“We believe that to create an exciting and comprehensive #DRIVE Rally experience, it is crucial to fine-tune it based on feedback from our community. We seek your support and feedback!

As a genuinely small team with significant ambitions, we want to share our work with you, continuing development with your support and feedback in mind.

Therefore, we have decided to release #DRIVE Rally into Early Access."[/i]

[h2]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h2]
[i]"We plan to enhance the game's quality by making various improvements throughout Early Access for at least one year. 

We aim to focus on every aspect of the game with the right approach. During Early Access, we will regularly update the game, actively adding content and improving in-game systems.

Depending on the progress of development, we may consider extending Early Access or, if satisfied with the game's state, officially releasing it."[/i]

[h2]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h2]

[i]"We plan to include various additional elements, focusing on adding new content and balance adjustments based on community feedback.

This includes the addition of new cars to expand our garage, new maps and tracks to race on, new Co-Pilots to drive with, and additional car customization parts and items. This allows you to build your cars from the ground up to match your racing style. Personalize the body, paintwork, decals, and add custom decorations on top.

We're also eager to incorporate feedback from our community, considering additional features and ideas that may come directly from our drivers."[/i]

[h2]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h2]

[i]"The core systems of the #DRIVE Rally experience, such as map generation, track creation, and physics, are already complete."[/i]

[h2]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h2]

[i]"With the full version's price at official launch, we aim to keep it at the same level."[/i]

[h2]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h2]

[i]"With a #DRIVE community of car enthusiasts on our Discord Server (http://discord.gg/drivegame), #DRIVE Rally is more than a game; it's a community, a tribute, and a thrilling racing adventure rolled into one. We are eager to hear your feedback in various places, including the Steam forums, Twitter, Discord, and other social networking sites."[/i]

[h2]#DRIVE Rally – key features:[/h2]
● Easy to learn, hard to master – a simple and intuitive driving model that even 
beginners will handle with ease. However, challenging trials await those who know 
well the sound of gravel under their tires. This system is designed to showcase the 
fun of racing games.

● Don't cut! – the co-driver can be the most loyal fan or the sternest judge. Enjoy 
victories together, but be prepared for criticism after losses.

● Nostalgic vehicles – take the wheel of legendary rally cars such as Das Holzwagen, 
The Doggo, The Bobond, and many more. #DRIVE Rally is now taking players on a 
nostalgic journey to the '90s, introducing new additions, including Das Sandsturm 
and Celestia, awaiting in the pits.

● Triumph with style – build your cars from the base to perfectly match your driving 
style, allowing you to compete on your own terms. Personalize the body, paint, and 
designs, while the boldest players can look forward to custom decorations.

● Postcards from rallies – from the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the 
whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli. Compete in 
diverse settings unlike any you have experienced in racing games. Get creative and 
capture your most epic moments in #DRIVE Rally with the special photo mode.

● Join a community of rally fans – ready to dive deeper into this world? Join a 
dedicated Discord server, where every member can be your co-driver.
